messages:
asha: Heads up — proposing a lightweight overnight handoff cadence for this week. Quick check: who's on for escalation coverage 22:00-06:00 PT? Draft agenda below.

asha: ```
1) Quick rollcall (22:00)
2) 10-min async triage on current open incidents (22:05)
3) Escalation liaison responsibilities and contact list
4) Any planned infra work that could impact night coverage
5) Post-shift summary + followups (06:00)
```

mike: I can take Tue/Wed nights.

jordan: I can take Thu.

sam: Prefer not to do midnight->3am if avoided, but can be backup for Mon/Tue.

charlie: If I'm primary Wed night, can we confirm pager rotation changes in case of callthroughs?

asha: Yep — mike, can you update the pager rotation doc and add explicit callthrough steps? link: https://company.internal/rota (pls add your shifts)

mike: Done — added Tue/Wed. Also will be escalation liaison for infra-gtw.

jordan: Suggest we have a 10-min pinned triage window at 22:05 where the night crew posts a short status in this thread. Keeps async overhead low.

asha: :thumbsup: good call. Make it a hard 10 minutes so daytime can catch up.

sam: Works for me.

mike: Can we also have a short post-shift template? saves followup noise.

charlie: I'll draft that template now.

charlie: ```
POST-SHIFT SUMMARY (use same subject):
- INC (IDs): comma-separated
- Impact: brief (users, customers, services)
- Actions taken: bullet list
- Outstanding follow-ups: who, ETA
- Notes for next shift:
```

asha: Nice. One more: @oncall-bot can you schedule a nightly reminder at 21:50 PT to prompt the rollcall?

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: daily at 21:50 PT. I will ping #eng-oncall with the rota link 10 minutes before shift start.

jordan: Also, small ask: if there's a page from infra-gtw, escalate to @mike first, then to SRE lead (cc: @charlie) if no ack in 5 min. Can we make that explicit in the escalation doc?

mike: Agree, I'll add the 5-min ack step and SRE lead contact.

asha: Finalizing rota by 18:00 today. If you can't take an assigned slot, either swap in the rota doc or ping here so we can reassign.

sam: Noted — I'll flag any conflicts by 17:30.

asha: Thanks all. If no objections, we'll run this as a 1-week trial and gather feedback next Friday. :sparkles:

mike: SGTM.

jordan: SGTM.

charlie: SGTM, will monitor incident queue Wed night and report.

oncall-bot: Note: recurring triage message template posted to the channel on schedule.

asha: Closing thread — agenda & rota set. Ping me if you need to swap. :handshake:
